catalogName: Google Ads Campaign Type and Resource Hierarchy Catalog
purpose: Implementation planning catalog for a unified campaign builder. This is a normalized application-side capability catalog, not a literal Google Ads API request body.
criticalRules: Google Ads API does not expose one universal native Campaign Objective field equivalent to the Google Ads UI objective picker. Store a normalized business objective in your app and map it to valid API resources/settings.
Campaign type controls the resource hierarchy, eligible ad formats, targeting, network/channel settings and bidding options.
Campaign budget is a separate CampaignBudget resource referenced by Campaign.campaign_budget; budget amount fields use micros and the account currency applies.
CampaignCriterion and AdGroupCriterion are separate resources; choose the correct level and criterion type for the campaign type.
Validate the selected configuration against the current API version, account eligibility, conversion setup, feed/account links and campaign-type-specific rules before mutation.
Use only documented API operations. Existing/readable campaign types are not necessarily creatable or fully mutable through the API.
Use idempotency and reconcile uncertain create outcomes before retrying; store provider resource names and IDs after every successful mutation.

campaignName.description: Human-readable shared name; map to a valid provider campaign name.

businessObjective.description: Internal normalized value only; not a universal Google Ads API enum.

budget.description: Never assume amount and currency can be applied unchanged to every connected ad account. Google account currency is generally determined by the account.

market.description: Targeting availability and allowed targeting level depend on campaign type; Search does not support manual campaign language criteria in the standard Search setup guide.

providerSettings.description: Type-specific Google configuration shown after selecting the campaign type.

sharedApiObjects.Customer: Google Ads account/customer that owns campaign resources.

notes: Create non-shared budget for campaign types that require it.
Daily versus total/lifetime budget support varies by campaign type.
advertising_channel_type and subtype are set at creation and are not generally changeable later.
API uses CampaignStatus values such as PAUSED or ENABLED; safe product launch flow should default to PAUSED where supported.

sharedApiObjects.CampaignCriterion: Campaign-level targeting or exclusions, for example location, device, schedule, negative keyword, or other type-supported criteria.
sharedApiObjects.AdGroup: Container for ads and ad-group-level settings in campaign types that use ad groups.
sharedApiObjects.AdGroupCriterion: Ad-group-level targeting, for example keywords, audience criteria, placements, or product/hotel listing-group rules depending on campaign type.
sharedApiObjects.AdGroupAd: Link/resource connecting an ad to an ad group.
sharedApiObjects.Ad: Contains a campaign-type-specific ad info union and often final URLs; actual fields depend on ad type.
sharedApiObjects.Asset: Reusable creative component such as headline, description, image, logo or video.
sharedApiObjects.CampaignAsset / AdGroupAsset: Optional links attaching compatible assets to campaign/ad-group levels.
sharedApiObjects.ConversionGoalCampaignConfig / CampaignC: Optional goal configuration used when campaign-level conversion goals need to override account-level goals.

SEARCH.resourceHierarchy: Customer -> CampaignBudget -> Campaign(SEARCH) -> AdGroup -> [AdGroupCriterion(keyword/audience/other supported criteria), AdGroupAd -> Ad(ResponsiveSearchAdInfo or supported Search ad type)]

requiredForServing: at least one AdGroupCriterion (for standard keyword-targeted setup)
typicalChildren: CampaignAsset or AdGroupAsset(sitelink/callout/call/structured snippet/image assets as supported)

biddingStrategyExamples: Manual CPC where supported
Maximize Clicks
Maximize Conversions with optional target CPA
Maximize Conversion Value with optional target ROAS
Target Impression Share where supported
other strategy only if v26 and account/context accepts it
prerequisites: Google Ads customer with billing and API access
Final URL and Search ad assets
notes: Display expansion is a Search network setting, not a separate advertising_channel_type.
AI Max is an optional optimization layer within Search, not a separate campaign type.

DISPLAY.resourceHierarchy: Customer -> CampaignBudget -> Campaign(DISPLAY) -> AdGroup -> [AdGroupCriterion(targeting), AdGroupAd -> Ad(ResponsiveDisplayAdInfo or another supported Display ad type)]

requiredForServing: AdGroupAd with an eligible display ad
typicalChildren: Asset and AdGroupAsset/CampaignAsset for compatible extra assets

biddingStrategyExamples: Manual CPC where supported
Maximize Clicks where supported
Maximize Conversions with optional target CPA
Maximize Conversion Value with optional target ROAS
other strategy only if v26 and context permits
prerequisites: Audience, placement or other targeting as appropriate
notes: Display uses ad groups and ads; supported asset links can add sitelinks/callouts or similar assets.
Do not assume every legacy Display subtype is creatable.

PERFORMANCE_MAX.resourceHierarchy: Customer -> CampaignBudget(non-shared, daily) -> Campaign(PERFORMANCE_MAX) -> AssetGroup -> Asset + AssetGroupAsset; optional AssetGroupSignal; optional AssetSet/CampaignAsset and product listing filters for relevant use cases

requiredForServing: required AssetGroupAsset links/assets meeting minimums (unless supported retail/other documented exception)
typicalChildren: Asset(text headlines/long headlines/descriptions/images/videos/logos/business name/final URL as applicable)
AssetGroupSignal(audience and/or search themes; hints, not strict targeting)
CampaignAsset(brand name/logo when brand guidelines enabled)
AssetSet/AssetSetAsset only for supported linked inventory

biddingStrategyExamples: Maximize Conversions with optional target CPA
Maximize Conversion Value with optional target ROAS
prerequisites: Sufficient required text/image/brand assets unless supported retail exceptions apply
notes: No standard AdGroup/Ad hierarchy for normal Performance Max; the creative unit is AssetGroup.
PMax has limited manual placement control; audience signals are hints, not restrictive audience targeting.
PMax for Travel Goals and Local Services PMax have extra subtype-specific requirements.

DEMAND_GEN.resourceHierarchy: Customer -> CampaignBudget(non-shared; supported budget period) -> Campaign(DEMAND_GEN) -> AdGroup -> [AdGroupCriterion(audience/location/language as supported), AdGroupAd -> Ad(DemandGenMultiAssetAdInfo | DemandGenCarouselAdInfo | DemandGenVideoResponsiveAdInfo | DemandGenProductAdInfo)]

requiredForServing: eligible AdGroupAd/Ad and required creative assets
typicalChildren: Ad with DemandGenMultiAssetAdInfo or DemandGenCarouselAdInfo or DemandGenVideoResponsiveAdInfo or feed-backed DemandGenProductAdInfo

performanceGoalConcepts: VIDEO_VIEWS/ENGAGEMENT where supported by eligible setup
biddingStrategyExamples: Maximize Clicks where eligible
Maximize Conversions with optional target CPA where eligible
Maximize Conversion Value with optional target ROAS where eligible
only show strategies validated for chosen Demand Gen configuration
prerequisites: Product feed/Merchant Center link if using product ads
notes: Uses ad groups and ads plus modern assets (hybrid hierarchy).
Uses DemandGenChannelControls rather than generic Search network settings.
Budget must not be shared; API documents support for total budgets through the applicable budget period fields.

SHOPPING.resourceHierarchy: Customer -> CampaignBudget -> Campaign(SHOPPING + ShoppingSetting) -> AdGroup(type SHOPPING_PRODUCT_ADS) -> [AdGroupAd(ShoppingProductAdInfo), AdGroupCriterion(product listing groups/subdivision and exclusions)]

requiredForServing: Google Ads and Merchant Center linked
shopping product ad and valid feed/product eligibility

biddingStrategyExamples: Manual CPC where supported
Maximize Clicks where supported
Maximize Conversion Value with optional target ROAS where eligible
validate additional strategies against Shopping eligibility
notes: Standard Shopping is API-creatable.
New Smart Shopping campaigns cannot be created; use Performance Max for cross-channel retail.
AI Max support exists for Search and Shopping as an optional feature, not a new campaign type.

APP_CAMPAIGN.resourceHierarchy: Customer -> CampaignBudget(non-shared) -> Campaign(MULTI_CHANNEL + AppCampaignSetting/subtype-specific goal) -> AdGroup -> [AdGroupAd -> app-ad asset configuration]; optional AdGroupCriterion for selective optimization/user lists

requiredForServing: Campaign with app_campaign_setting and matching subtype/goal/bidding
eligible app ad/assets and app store/app ID details
typicalChildren: AdGroupAd/Ad with supported app ad info and text/image/video assets
AdGroupCriterion(user list criteria for selected in-app action use cases)
conversion actions/selective optimization depending on subtype

biddingStrategyExamples: Goal-dependent automated bidding; show only options supported by app subtype and goal, such as install/action/value-focused strategies
prerequisites: Valid Android/iOS app identification and store presence
Correct app campaign subtype and goal
Conversion/in-app event setup for action/value optimization
notes: App campaigns have advertising_channel_type MULTI_CHANNEL and a subtype-specific configuration.
The legacy App Campaign for installs workflow is not supported by the Google Ads API; implement only the currently documented supported subtype/goal combinations.
Do not offer portfolio strategy or shared campaign budget for App campaigns.

HOTEL.resourceHierarchy: Customer -> CampaignBudget -> Campaign(HOTEL + HotelSettingInfo) -> AdGroup(type HOTEL_ADS) -> AdGroupAd(HotelAdInfo); optional HotelListingGroupInfo/listing-group criteria

requiredForServing: Hotel Center linked to Google Ads
Hotel AdGroup and supported ad/resource configuration
typicalChildren: Hotel listing groups via supported listing-group criteria
ad group bids and bid modifiers

biddingStrategyExamples: Percent CPC (classic documented setup)
Target ROAS or Maximize Conversion Value where supported; check account and current API rules
prerequisites: Hotel Center account and linked hotel inventory
Feeds/pricing configured in Hotel Center/appropriate travel feed systems
notes: Hotel Ads API support is allowlist-dependent.
Hotel feeds and pricing are managed outside Google Ads API in Hotel Center/Travel Partner systems.
Do not confuse Hotel Ads (HOTEL) with Performance Max for Travel Goals (PERFORMANCE_MAX + TRAVEL_GOALS).

PERFORMANCE_MAX_TRAVEL_GOALS.resourceHierarchy: Customer -> CampaignBudget(non-shared, daily) -> Campaign(PERFORMANCE_MAX, subtype TRAVEL_GOALS) -> Hotel property AssetSet(type HOTEL_PROPERTY) -> AssetSetAsset links; Campaign.hotel_property_asset_set -> AssetGroup -> AssetGroupAsset

requiredForServing: CampaignBudget with daily period and not shared
Campaign with PERFORMANCE_MAX and TRAVEL_GOALS subtype
AssetGroup and required AssetGroupAsset resources/assets per campaign rules
typicalChildren: CampaignCriterion and conversion goals as supported

biddingStrategyExamples: Maximize Conversions with optional target CPA
Maximize Conversion Value with optional target ROAS
notes: This is a subtype of Performance Max, not a separate advertising_channel_type.
Requires hotel property asset set and special subtype value TRAVEL_GOALS.

LOCAL_SERVICES_PERFORMANCE_MAX.resourceHierarchy: Customer -> CampaignBudget -> Campaign(PERFORMANCE_MAX + LocalServicesPmaxCampaignSettings) -> AssetGroup -> AssetGroupAsset; specialized Local Services listing/service identifiers and country settings

requiredForServing: Campaign with required LocalServicesPmaxCampaignSettings fields including listing_id and country_code in v26
AssetGroup and required assets subject to Local Services PMax rules

biddingStrategyExamples: Use only strategy types explicitly supported for this special PMax subtype; runtime validate required fields/eligibility
notes: This is a special PMax subtype/configuration, not the legacy LOCAL_SERVICES advertising_channel_type.
Google Ads API v26 release notes identify listing_id and country_code as required at creation. Treat it as an advanced later feature, not the default campaign builder.

TRAVEL_ACTIVITIES.resourceHierarchy: Customer -> CampaignBudget -> Campaign(TRAVEL + TRAVEL_ACTIVITIES subtype) -> activity-related campaign/ad-group/criteria resources as permitted for the account and API release

typicalChildren: Travel activity group/criterion resources where enabled
requiredForServing: Must be established from the current v26 travel-activities-specific API guide and eligibility; do not infer solely from enum existence

biddingStrategyExamples: Only strategies accepted by the travel-activities-specific API flow
notes: The v26 field reference includes TRAVEL and TRAVEL_ACTIVITIES enum values; an enum value alone is not proof the workflow is generally available or supports all create operations.

VIDEO.resourceHierarchy: Existing resources may appear as Campaign(VIDEO) -> AdGroup -> AdGroupAd/Video ads and criteria; use for reporting/read operations only
biddingStrategyExamples: Do not expose creation/update bidding choices through the Google Ads API for legacy Video campaigns
notes: Google Ads API documentation says Video campaigns can be queried/reported but cannot be created or updated through the API.
For new programmatic video workflows, evaluate Demand Gen or Performance Max instead.

SMART.resourceHierarchy: Existing campaign: Customer -> CampaignBudget -> Campaign(SMART/SMART_CAMPAIGN) -> SmartCampaignSetting and supported existing campaign resources

legacyChildren: campaign budget and supported existing settings

biddingStrategyExamples: Do not expose new Smart campaign bid setup; only supported management of existing campaigns
notes: The current official Smart campaign guide says creation is deprecated starting September 23, 2026; existing settings can still be updated.

LOCAL_SERVICES_LEGACY.resourceHierarchy: Existing Campaign(LOCAL_SERVICES) and reporting/lead resources; no normal create-new Campaign -> AdGroup -> Ad flow via API

unsupportedCreateOperations: create/modify/delete typical sub-entities such as ad groups, ads or criteria

biddingStrategyExamples: Manual CPA or Maximize Conversions only where documented for existing Local Services campaign contexts
prerequisites: Existing Local Services Ads account and supported access
notes: Do not confuse this legacy channel with the newer Local Services Performance Max configuration.

LOCAL_LEGACY.resourceHierarchy: Legacy/existing Local campaign resources; modern local objectives are commonly handled via Performance Max or eligible Local Services products

legacyChildren: existing campaign and any exposed resources depending on account/API support

biddingStrategyExamples: Use only options returned as supported for the existing resource/account
notes: LOCAL remains an enum in the v26 Campaign field reference, but support for a legacy channel enum does not imply a modern general-purpose create workflow. Verify specific docs/account support before implementation.
For a general business website, Search and Performance Max are practical first integrations.
For e-commerce, add Standard Shopping after Merchant Center linkage; Performance Max can also support retail.
For app promotion, require app-specific inputs and subtype selection.
Treat Hotel and Local Services as vertical-specific products with specialized onboarding.

runtimeCapabilityContract.designPrinciple: Frontend renders the form from backend-supplied capabilities; do not hardcode a single global objective/performance-goal/bidding list.

validationWarnings: Bidding choices are illustrative until validated for the exact campaign/account setup.
Final eligible choices must be checked against current v26 enums/rules and account state.

validationPipeline: validate budget period and shared-budget restrictions
validate bidding scheme and conditional values
validate targeting level and criteria types
reconcile uncertain API timeout before retry
